search_order_rule: Existing repository evidence -> named unresolved threat -> targeted search only -> stop when named question is resolved or documented unavailable.

searches.trigger: Named post-lock source T1 in docs/literature/THESIS_READING_LIST_CURRENT_VI.md was not present in W09 canonical packets.
searches.scientific_question: Does Yang, Guo & Wang 2025 already perform an equivalent model-validity/breakdown experiment for a vacuum layer-jamming beam/plate?
searches.concept_family: experimental layer-jamming characterization; vacuum layer-jamming; validity-domain studies
searches.query_family: exact title + DOI; publisher full text
query_terms: Behavior of layer jamming plate with tunable stiffness and its near wake structure in cross flow
searches.database_or_source: Scientific Reports / Nature; repository named-target list
searches.screening_rule: Promote only if source identity and full text are verified; distinguish physical slip-regime mapping from model-validity boundary mapping.
searches.full_text_promotion_rule: Full text must expose model, experiment, domain and whether validity/error boundary is actually evaluated.
searches.stop_condition: Stop when full text establishes whether the study contains M1-equivalent reduced/reference model-form error mapping and predicted boundary-crossing experiment.
searches.human_review_trigger: Any direct/partial conceptual equivalence to NC-02/NC-04.
searches.closure_reason: Full text was verified. It provides direct vacuum-LJ experiments over layer count/vacuum pressure and physical slip regimes, but no Zhang-type M1 versus interface-resolved reference model-form error map, no predeclared model-validity tolerance, and no deliberate experiment across a predicted model-validity boundary.

searches.trigger: Named post-lock source T2 in docs/literature/THESIS_READING_LIST_CURRENT_VI.md was not present in W09 canonical packets and could overlap the D1 M→R→E workflow.
searches.scientific_question: Does Wang et al. 2026 quantify validity/model-form error of an MLJ analytical model and deliberately test a predicted validity boundary under vacuum?
searches.concept_family: vacuum layer-jamming; model validation; model-form error; validity-domain studies
searches.query_family: exact title + DOI; publisher and institutional-repository retrieval
query_terms: Multilayer jamming-reinforced inflatable systems for rapidly deployable lightweight construction
searches.database_or_source: Materials & Design / ScienceDirect; TU Delft Repository
searches.screening_rule: Abstract may nominate threat only; K-test classification requires full text for mechanics/error/boundary claims.
searches.full_text_promotion_rule: Promote to K-test evidence only after full text resolves model/reference/error/criterion timing and experiment design.
searches.stop_condition: Obtain full text and classify whether M, R and E roles plus validity/breakdown boundary are substantively present; otherwise document unavailability without using no-hit as absence.
searches.human_review_trigger: New 2026 direct vacuum-MLJ source with analytical model and experiments.
searches.closure_reason: Publisher and TU Delft metadata/abstract were verified and an open-access PDF was identified, but the full PDF could not be retrieved within this execution environment. Abstract-only evidence is insufficient for K1-K9 classification.
